versions.text: (a) A horizontal tail balancing load is a load necessary to maintain equilibrium in any specified flight condition with no pitching acceleration. (b) Horizontal tail surfaces must be designed for the balancing loads occurring at any point on the limit maneuvering envelope and in the flap conditions specified in Sec. 23.345. The distribution in figure 6 of Appendix B may be used.
